description: 30 fixed planning briefs: 10 greenfield new-book, 10 chapter-horizon continuation, 10 mid-book replan/amendment. Includes single and rotating POV, standalone/series/serial modes, known cast/world constraints and deliberately conflicting replan inputs. Fixture plans built from these briefs are labelled fixtures, not model output.

briefs.name: The Clapperless Bell
briefs.premise: The Clapperless Bell: A fair-play coastal mystery where every clue has a material cost. The central pressure is the harbor's evacuation.
briefs.contract_promise: A fair-play coastal mystery where every clue has a material cost.
constraints: Keep every scene within the general content ceiling.
Use only the declared cast and locations.
Plant the promise before it pays off.
Do not rewrite drafted prose or accepted canon.

world_rules.description: The tidal gate opens at dawn and cannot be forced.

promises.description: Who rang the clapperless bell?

chapters.turn: Mara hears the clapperless bell and finds fresh salt on the locked bell rope.
scenes: Mara notices the clapperless bell at Watchtower and keeps the first clue hidden.
Mara asks Ivo for help and pays a small price for silence.

chapters.turn: Mara trades her archive key for a tide chart and loses Ivo's trust.
scenes: Mara follows a lead that costs the harbor's evacuation.
Mara chooses between the clue and Ivo's safety.

chapters.turn: Mara confronts Vell with the forged signal log and chooses what to reveal.
scenes: Mara confronts Vell with the recovered proof.
Mara decides what to reveal about the clapperless bell.

briefs.open_question: Should Ivo know about the forged log before the final confrontation?
